title: A Visit to the Market
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hello, Adam. Are you going to the market?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا آدم. هل أنت ذاهب إلى السوق؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, Lina. I need some vegetables.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم يا لينا. أحتاج إلى بعض الخضراوات.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Can I come with you?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Of course. Let's make a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: We need tomatoes, potatoes, and onions.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: How many tomatoes do we need?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: We need five tomatoes, please.
dialogue.translation_ar: نحتاج إلى خمس حبات طماطم، من فضلك.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: And how many potatoes?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Four potatoes are enough.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Look at these fresh apples.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: They look delicious. Let's buy three.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: How much are the apples?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: They are two dollars each.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: That is six dollars for three apples.
dialogue.translation_ar: أي ستة دولارات لثلاث حبات تفاح.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do we need anything else?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل نحتاج إلى أي شيء آخر؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, we need a bottle of water.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I have a shopping bag in my hand.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Good. We don't need a new bag.
dialogue.translation_ar: جيد. لا نحتاج إلى حقيبة جديدة.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Let's pay at the counter now.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Okay. Then we can go home.
dialogue.translation_ar: حسنًا. ثم يمكننا العودة إلى المنزل.

questions.question: How many tomatoes do they need?
How much do three apples cost?
